messages:
harper: FYI — customer ACME hit an issue after a mid-cycle upgrade. Invoice INV-2026-987 ended up with two separate prorate credit notes instead of one consolidated credit. Customer has PO: PO-12345 and tax_exempt=true. They saw invoice balance still nonzero. :facepalm:
zoe: Can you paste the invoice JSON + event trace? :eyes:
harper: Invoice JSON snippet:
```json
{
  "id": "INV-2026-987",
  "account": "acct_78b",
  "lines": [
    {"plan": "core", "prorate": -12.5},
    {"plan": "addon", "prorate": -12.5}
  ],
  "credit_notes": [
    {"id": "CN-333", "amount": -12.5},
    {"id": "CN-334", "amount": -12.5}
  ],
  "po": "PO-12345",
  "tax_exempt": true
}
```
Events: billing-worker created prorate for core at 15:23:05Z, upgrade job retried at 15:23:06Z and created second credit note. Looks like duplicate refund flow.
sam: Steps to repro?
harper: Quick repro notes (what I ran locally):
1) create acct w/ two active subscriptions (core + addon) and mark account.po_required = true + tax_exempt = true
2) create PO-12345 on account via UI
3) call upgrade API twice in quick succession: `curl -X POST /v1/subscriptions/sub_abc/upgrade -d '{"to_plan":"pro"}'` (ran 2x within 500ms)
4) observe two prorate jobs in /events and two credit_notes created

Logs: ```
2026-03-12T15:23:05Z INFO prorate-processor: created CN-333 for INV-2026-987
2026-03-12T15:23:06Z WARN upgrade-job: retry triggered for sub_abc (attempt 2)
2026-03-12T15:23:06Z INFO prorate-processor: created CN-334 for INV-2026-987
2026-03-12T15:23:06Z ERROR billing: invoice balance mismatch after credit creation
```
devon: Sounds like a race between the subscriptions-upgrade job and the prorate processor. My hunch: refund/credit creation path lacks a deterministic idempotency key (we use ephemeral session key right now), so retries create duplicate CNs. Also check db unique constraint on db.credit_notes_unique_idx — maybe not covering invoice+period+account combo. Assigning to @sam + @devon to investigate. :bug:
sam: I'll try to repro in staging. Noted an API 500 when a duplicate CN is attempted in prod during an earlier run. Error snippet: ```ERROR: duplicate creditnote idempotency constraint violation at db:credit_notes_unique_idx```
billing-bot: Alert — Created credit note CN-334 for INV-2026-987 (trigger: prorate-processor) at 2026-03-12T15:23:06Z
zoe: :thumbsup: Want me to reach out to the account team to pause auto-refund while we investigate?
harper: Yes please pause. Customer asked for manual reversal and a corrected consolidated credit note for full prorated amount. I've opened support ticket SUP-5567 and added accounting.
sam: Root cause hypothesis: idempotency key generation is session-based. Proposed fix: switch to deterministic key based on (account_id, invoice_period_id, subscription_id, action_type). I'll put up a PR to change the refund creation call to accept external idempotency_key computed in the upgrade path. Patch + tests lined up, requesting a hotfix release. In the short term run manual reconcile: `python tools/reconcile_prorates.py --invoice INV-2026-987 --merge-duplicates`
devon: Additional gotcha — tax_exempt flag isn't being propagated from invoice -> credit_note metadata path, so tax calculation differs between the invoice lines and the created CNs which caused the accounting delta even after merging. Need to ensure credit notes copy invoice.tax_exempt and copy PO metadata (PO-12345) to CNs.
harper: OK. I'll coordinate manual correction with finance and notify customer that we will issue a single corrected credit note and reverse the duplicate. Will update SUP-5567 when done. Thanks all.
